title: Vanilla Music Disc (Okau)
description: This is a mod that adds new vanilla music discs.
body:
This mod adds 11+ new music discs to the game around the world that fit in with vanilla. They can be found throughout the world in various corresponding locations. All the songs on the discs are not mine! The songwriters' names are listed on the discs. I simply developed the mod.


![First nine discs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd5b0504a2cf0f27ac892e66b37a68df1d14ffa1.png)

All music discs are an interesting part of the game world and fit well into the overall loot collection, adding additional information about the vanilla version of the game and modpacks vanilla+.
11 discs have been added so far. How to get them?

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

_"No Escape"_ - in the chests of the mines.
_"Primary"_ - sniffer will dig it up.
_"Hymn"_ - during the raid.
_"Usless breeze"_ - can be found in the mansion.
_"Warmer"_ - can be found in the snow village.
_"Expanse"_ - can be dug up in treasures.
_"Your area"_ - crafting on a forge table.
_"Mind fog"_ - crafting on a forge table.
_"Spoils"_ - It can be found in chests in the mines and the ancient city.
_"Wreckage"_ - in the chests of the mines.

</details>
